cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For your sister's wedding, should I book us one room or two?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Double bed, then, or shall I ask for twins?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Twins. I don't want to confuse things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. At breakfast, do I sit with your family or wait for you in the lobby?

comparison: Towel alternative probes whether a permanent place remains at home; wedding alternative probes bed arrangement then public family inclusion.
